Fat Stigma Fuels Weight Bullying (New York Times)

From the article:

“It is actually legal to discriminate on the basis of weight, and that sends a message that bias, unfair treatment or bullying of overweight children is tolerable,” Dr. Puhl, a professor of human development and families studies at UConn, said.

As obesity rates have risen, she said, so much emphasis has been placed on taking personal responsibility for body weight and changing behaviors “that there is a perception that these youth are somehow to blame for their weight and in some way deserve this treatment.”

Hm, I don't really agree that the legality of illegality of weight discrimination has an impact on children. Legality or illegality doesn't necessarily impact the way adults express their opinions to their children in private.
Kids shouldn't be bullied for being fat, but the fact is that being overweight can be changed. If you're a parent and see your child being bullied, get more active and help them lose weight.
Newsflash. People are disgusted with people who are unhealthy. Lance a boil some time. Being obese is unhealthy. The fact that it's voluntary just takes away the sympathy.

Natural springs per 100 square kilometres in Finland [PNG 1061x1691] [OC]

I made a map of the number of natural springs in Finland per 100 km². The data is from the open data of the national mapping agency, namely springs of the geographic database (surprise!). Also included are the borders of Finland and the arms of the Baltic Sea.

The scale has equal number of springs/square in each category. The gaps may exist because of the data but in the north and southeast the big gaps are because of large lakes in the areas (Inarijärvi and Saimaa, respectively). Also, the region around Oulu (the narrowest part of Finland) has very flat geography and there might not be a lot of suitable places.
